status_summary: Executive Order 14303 (signed 2025-05-23) directed OSTP to issue Gold Standard Science guidance, which it published on 2025-06-23 with a 60-day agency reporting requirement. The order requires agencies to reevaluate and revise or rescind scientific integrity policies issued between 2021-01-20 and 2025-01-20. Its background text criticizes diversity, equity and inclusion considerations in science but it has no operative directive on them; separately, the National Science Foundation began terminating awards focused on diversity, equity and inclusion in April 2025. No policy separating risk assessment from risk management by that name was found.

timeline.event: The National Science Foundation began terminating awards it judged outside its priorities, including grants focused on diversity, equity and inclusion and on misinformation and disinformation.
Executive Order 14303, Restoring Gold Standard Science, was signed (published 2025-05-29).
OSTP issued agency guidance for implementing Gold Standard Science, with agencies to report publicly within 60 days.

title: Separate risk assessment from management; unwind equity initiatives in science policy
uncertainties: Agency implementation plans were not individually reviewed. One web search for litigation over the order found no court case. An EPA memo implementing the order on risk assessments is tracked in c13-05 and was not assessed here for whether it separates assessment from management. EPA science is covered by c13-05 and government-wide removal of DEI terms by c00-01. The progress figure is an inference from the order and guidance being operative but only partly matching the recommendation.
